summary: Tested backend endpoints (locations with type field, geo/search auth, content value_id) and full admin UI flows (Locations CMS with Nominatim city autocomplete + coords paste; Home locations list + dynamic stats; Subsidiaries map legend; Pillars '+ Tambah Pointer' add/remove). All targeted features in review request work. One pre-existing issue: superadmin login (admin@sunjayaasia.com / sunjaya-superadmin-2026) returns 401 — editor login works and was used for all admin UI tests.

critical.issue: Super admin login fails with 'Invalid email or password' using documented credentials (admin@sunjayaasia.com / sunjaya-superadmin-2026). admin_users row exists but stored password_hash doesn't match env SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Likely the DB row was seeded earlier with a different password and _seed_superadmin_if_empty() only seeds when the table is empty, so .env changes don't propagate. Editor (editorpass123) works. This blocks /auth/users (Users tab) which requires superadmin.

test_results.backend_pytest: 5/5 PASS — test_locations_has_9_with_types, test_geo_search_requires_auth (401 w/o token), test_geo_search_with_bearer (returns Surabaya lat~-7.26, lng~112.74), test_geo_search_with_legacy_token, test_content_value_id_create_and_update (POST+PUT+GET persistence verified)
test_results.locations_types: 9 items: Singapore=hq, Panama=infra, Switzerland=infra, Jakarta/Batam/Balikpapan/Dubai/Beijing+other=branch — matches spec
test_results.admin_locations_e2e: PASS — logged in as editor, loc-type-select / loc-country-select (country list incl Japan+UAE+USA...) / loc-city-input with Nominatim results (loc-city-option-0 fills admin-lat=34.6938 admin-lng=135.5015 for Osaka,JP) / loc-coords-paste '-6.2, 106.8' fills lat/lng / loc-role-select (dropdown w/ existing roles) / loc-save creates Osaka. After save: Home home-locations-list contains Osaka, stats stat-branches=8 stat-infra=2 stat-countries=8 (baseline 7/2/7 confirmed after cleanup); /subsidiaries map-legend-list contains Osaka. loc-delete-Osaka removes it.
test_results.home_subsidiary_cards: PASS — home-sub-card-* elements render as <A> tags with href='/subsidiaries'
test_results.content_bilingual_fields: PASS — content-input-nav.home (EN) and content-input-nav.home-id (ID) both present. Switching lang to ID renders 'Beranda | Tentang | Pilar | Anak Perusahaan…' confirming ID language context works. Backend POST/PUT content with value_id persistence verified via pytest.
test_results.pillars_add_remove_pointer: PASS — add-pointer-pillar_01 adds pillar.01.div.06.name + .desc blocks (5→6). /pillars page then shows 'New pointer'. remove-pointer-pillar.01.div.06.name (confirm dialog accepted) removes it (6→5). Full roundtrip clean.

action_items: Re-sync super admin password: either DELETE the admin@sunjayaasia.com row in admin_users so _seed_superadmin_if_empty re-seeds from env, OR change _seed_superadmin_if_empty to upsert the super admin password on every startup when SUPER_ADMIN_* env is set.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _seed_superadmin_if_empty() only runs when admin_users is entirely empty. If the super admin password rotates in .env, the DB is never updated, leaving documented credentials non-functional. Consider: on startup, upsert the SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL row with the current hashed SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD when env is set.

server.py:666 /geo/search uses limit=8 (int) but Nominatim 'params' expects strings via httpx — works but silently; also no caching, every keystroke hits Nominatim (OK for admin only but add client debounce).
/subsidiaries page shows map-legend-list correctly reflecting live DB locations — good single-source-of-truth design.
test_credentials: Admin login documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md is BROKEN for superadmin. Editor (editor@sunjayaasia.com / editorpass123) works and has access to all tabs except Users.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all test data (Osaka location, pillar.01.div.06 pointer, nav.home-id value) cleaned up.
